title: Lasha Ali Akbar Ka
body:
Haye Ali Akbar (as), Haye Ali Akbar (as)
Hai Baap Ke Haathon Par, Lasha Ali Akbar Ka
Maa Dekh Nahi Paayi, Sehra Ali Akbar Ka
1) Baba Ki Museebat Ko Akbar Bhi Samajh Paate (2x)
Duniya Mai Agar Hota, Beta Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Shabbir Ye Kehte Ta Marg Na Bhooloonga (2x)
Abbas Ke Do Baazu, Seena Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Shabbir Se Kehti Thi Hamsheer Yahi Aksar (2x)
Ye Aun o Muhammad Hain, Sadqa Ali Akbar Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Laila Se Koi Kehde Waapis Nahi Aayega (2x)
Ab Dekhle Jee Bhar Ke, Chehra Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Khat Koi Nahi Bheja Na Laut Ke Ghar Aaye (2x)
Takti Hi Rahi Rasta, Sughra Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Shabbir Ka Jeena Hai Shabbir Ka Marna Hai (2x)
Jeena Ali Akbar Ka, Marna Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Iss Chand Ke Seene Mai, Paiwast Hui Barchi (2x)
Parhti Thi Yahi Noha, Fizza Ali Akbar Ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Hai Mazher o Mesum Ki Aankhon Se Lahu Jaari (2x)
Asaan Nahi Parhna, Noha Ali Akbar Ka...
